newsitem.title: CHINA: China unable to meet demand for multi-media CDs.
newsitem.headline: China unable to meet demand for multi-media CDs.

text.p: China's demand for multi-media compact discs (CDs) is at least 15 million units a year but domestic producers are unable to meet that figure, the Legal Daily said on Monday.

China had 36 firms producing multi-media CDs but sales of domestically made multi-media products were only 1.5 million units, the newspaper quoted the State Press and Publications Administration as saying.
Huge amounts of imported products had hampered development of the domestic electronic publications industry, the newspaper said.
The large imports had made it difficult for the government to regulate the content of multi-media products, with many CDs containing pornographic materials, it said.
